meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 探索有潜力的深度学习研究方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做深度学习研究，需要系统探索和评估新方向
copy.tagline_en: Explore promising deep learning research directions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing deep learning research and need systematic exploration and evaluation of new directions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照严格的科研流程，帮你探索有潜力的深度学习研究方向。它会先理解你的研究背景，然后生成候选想法，进行实验并记录结果，确保过程可审计、可复现。
howto.when: 当你已经选定了任务、数据集、评估方法和SOTA参考，并明确授权进行探索性研究时触发。

say.text: 帮我探索一下这个模型在ImageNet上的改进方案。
say.note: Claude会开始理解仓库并生成候选想法。

say.text: 基于当前研究，生成几个候选实验并评估可行性。
say.note: Claude会进行想法筛选和排名。

say.text: 运行第一个候选实验并记录结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a rigorous research workflow to explore promising deep learning research directions. It understands your research context, generates candidate ideas, runs experiments, and records results in an auditable and reproducible manner.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have selected a task, dataset, evaluation method, and SOTA reference, and explicitly authorize exploratory research.

say_en.text: Explore improvements for this model on ImageNet.
say_en.note: Claude starts understanding the repo and generating ideas.

say_en.text: Generate and rank several candidate experiments based on current research.
Run the first candidate experiment and log results.
say_en.note: Claude executes and writes to explore_outputs.
